summary: Iteration 99: Backend + frontend testing for AI Tip History (Self-Assessment PDF) and Court Checklist card/PDF. 12/12 new backend tests pass; 25/25 regression tests (test_self_assessment.py, test_self_assessment_ai.py, test_court_path_ai.py) still green. Frontend Court Ordered page shows the court-checklist-card with all 10 rows, correct statuses, data-testids present, progress bar, and the download button produces a valid PDF with a success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: self_assessment_pdf.tip_history(): when `history` is empty the caller passes [entry] (see build_self_assessment_pdf line 364). This correctly supports anonymous callers (public /pdf endpoint) and matches the spec: section/overall tips from EVERY completed Self-Assessment appear; the current `entry` is included if history is empty.
court_checklist.build_checklist: safety row never leaks flagged status - detail is 'Completed' or empty - matches spec.
Minor: _box's partial-fill rect for 'in_progress' uses `s/2 - 0.9` for width which renders a thin bar; purely cosmetic, no fix needed.
seed_data_creation: Framing docs created during tests for parent2@test.com in self_assessment_framing_tips; cleanup fixture best-effort deletes same-day docs. The AI framing call during 'test_framing_endpoint_returns_shape' may leave 1-2 framing docs; non-sensitive (only advice/suggested, no user text).
